testCases.title: Verify pagination controls are displayed
steps: Navigate to the product listing page.
expectedResults: Pagination controls are displayed on the page.

testCases.title: Verify clicking a page number updates product grid
steps: Navigate to the product listing page.
Click on a page number in the pagination control.
expectedResults: The product grid updates to show products for the selected page.

testCases.title: Verify current page number is highlighted
steps: Navigate to the product listing page.
Observe the current page number in pagination controls.
expectedResults: The current page number is visually highlighted.
